keywords.def: specialised knowledge or skill gained through study or experience
influenced by or pushed forward by
describes a situation or mental state that is disorganised, chaotic or confused
a measure of difference, small details of which can affect an outcome

sentences.en: Hello, this is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 你好，这里是BBC英语教学的《6分钟英语》。

sentences.en: I'm Georgie. And I'm Neil. Neil, I'm not a huge fan of football, but I know you are.
sentences.zh: 我是Georgie。我是Neil。Neil，我对足球不是很感冒，但我知道你很喜欢。

sentences.en: So, why do you love it so much? Oh, where can I start?
sentences.zh: 所以，你为什么这么喜欢它呢？噢，从哪说起呢？

sentences.en: I think it's the combination of the passion and also the skill and athleticism of the players.
sentences.zh: 我觉得是激情、球员的球技以及运动能力的结合。

sentences.en: They call it 'the beautiful game' for a reason.
sentences.zh: 人们把它称为“美丽的运动”是有原因的。

sentences.en: Now, football players are faster than ever before, but the game is also about making very quick decisions.
sentences.zh: 现在，足球运动员比以往任何时候都跑得更快，但这项运动也关乎如何做出非常快速的决策。

sentences.en: Yes. To be the best of the best, some football clubs have started looking beyond the body, to the brain.
sentences.zh: 是的。为了精益求精，一些足球俱乐部已经开始将目光从身体延伸到了大脑。

sentences.en: Here's Tom Cooke, Academy Psychologist for Nottingham Forest Football Club, talking to the BBC World Service.
sentences.zh: 这里是诺丁汉森林足球俱乐部的学院心理学家Tom Cooke在对BBC世界服务频道说话。

sentences.en: We're watching these athletes make decisions in split instincts, under the highest pressures and the highest intensities.
sentences.zh: 我们正在观察这些运动员在极高的压力和极高的强度下，凭直觉瞬间做出决策。

sentences.en: It made a lot of sense to go, well, neurologically or cognitively, there's something going on.
sentences.zh: 去探索在神经学或认知学层面上，有些事情正在发生，这非常有意义。

sentences.en: There's something going on in the brain when the athletes are making quick decisions.
sentences.zh: 当运动员们做出快速决策时，他们的大脑中正在发生着某些变化。

sentences.en: If there's something going on, something unknown and interesting is happening.
sentences.zh: 如果有事情正在发生，那就说明有未知且有趣的事情正在上演。

sentences.en: So, what's happening inside the brains of football players?
sentences.zh: 那么，足球运动员的大脑内部究竟发生了什么？

sentences.en: And could brain training help win more games?
sentences.zh: 大脑训练能帮助赢得更多比赛吗？

sentences.en: That's what we'll be hearing about in this programme.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在本期节目中要听到的内容。

sentences.en: And don't forget to find a free transcript at bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 别忘了在bbclearningenglish.com上找到免费的节目文稿。

sentences.en: But first, Neil. I have a quiz question for you.
sentences.zh: 但首先，Neil。我有一个小测验要考考你。

sentences.en: As we've heard, football players have to make decisions in high-pressure situations, and their performance may be influenced by their emotional state and fear response.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所听到的，足球运动员必须在高压情况下做出决策，他们的表现可能会受到情绪状态和恐惧反应的影响。

sentences.en: But which part of the brain is best known for its role in processing fear and detecting threats?
sentences.zh: 但是，大脑的哪个部分最以为人知的功能是处理恐惧和检测威胁？

sentences.en: Is it:
sentences.zh: 是：

sentences.en: OK, well I'll reveal the answer later in the programme.
sentences.zh: 好的，我会在节目晚些时候公布答案。

sentences.en: In 2014, a group of Japanesescientists studied the brain of Brazilian football star Neymar.
sentences.zh: 2014年，一组日本科学家研究了巴西足球明星Neymar的大脑。

sentences.en: They found that his brain was a lot less active than the brains of his peers when he rotated his right ankle.
sentences.zh: 他们发现，当Neymar旋转右脚踝时，他的大脑活跃度比同龄人要低得多。

sentences.en: Here's Holly Bridge, Professor of Neuroscience at the University of Oxford talking about this research to the BBC World Service.
sentences.zh: 这里是牛津大学神经科学教授Holly Bridge在向BBC世界服务频道谈论这项研究。

sentences.en: That reduction in activity in Neymar's cortex reflects that he has absolute expertise in moving his feet.
sentences.zh: Neymar皮层活动的减少反映出他在移动双脚方面具有绝对的专业技能。

sentences.en: And it's essentially done with very, very little conscious effort.
sentences.zh: 而且这基本上是在几乎不需要有意识的努力下完成的。

sentences.en: Holly said Neymar has absolute expertise in moving his feet.
sentences.zh: Holly说Neymar在移动双脚方面有着绝对的专业技能。

sentences.en: Expertise means a high level of skill or knowledge gained with experience.
sentences.zh: 专业技能意味着通过经验获得的极高水平的技能或知识。

sentences.en: Neymar's expertise is shown without much conscious effort.
sentences.zh: Neymar的专业技能展现时无需太多有意识的努力。

sentences.en: Conscious describes something done with awareness, not by accident.
sentences.zh: 有意识的描述了伴随觉察而非偶然进行的事情。

sentences.en: So, if Neymar kicks the ball without much conscious effort, he plays without thinking too much.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果Neymar踢球时不需要太多有意识的努力，他踢球时就不会过度思考。

sentences.en: Decades after this research, football clubs are becoming more interested in brain data technology, even exploring whether a player's brain can be trained.
sentences.zh: 在这项研究数十年后，足球俱乐部对大脑数据技术越来越感兴趣，甚至在探索是否可以训练球员的大脑。

sentences.en: Here's Tom Cooke, Academy Psychologist for Nottingham Forest Football Club.
sentences.zh: 这里是诺丁汉森林足球俱乐部的学院心理学家Tom Cooke。

sentences.en: What we're doing is trying to design sessions but with cognition or neuroscience at the centre of it.
sentences.zh: 我们正在做的是尝试设计课程，但以认知或神经科学为核心。

sentences.en: So it could be something like they're not great at storing lots of information, so we're trying to overwhelm them, in a safe environment like training, that's where the development and improvement can happen to hopefully affect when they go out into games or cup competitions.
sentences.zh: 所以可能是这样的情况，比如他们不擅长储存大量信息，所以我们试图在安全的训练环境中让他们感到应接不暇，这就是发展和改进能够发生的地方，希望能对他们参加比赛或杯赛产生影响。

sentences.en: Training can help players deal with the pressures of the game.
sentences.zh: 训练可以帮助球员应对比赛的压力。

sentences.en: Here's Holly Bridge again, talking about how emotions can affect a player's game.
sentences.zh: 这里是Holly Bridge再次谈论情绪如何影响球员的比赛。

sentences.en: A lot of performance is also driven by your emotional state.
sentences.zh: 很多表现也受你的情绪状态驱动。

sentences.en: And that is something you can learn to control.
sentences.zh: 而这是你可以学会控制的。

sentences.en: How well a player performs is driven by their emotional state.
sentences.zh: 球员的表现如何是由他们的情绪状态驱动的。

sentences.en: Here, driven by means influenced by or pushed forward by.
sentences.zh: 在这里，“驱动于”的意思是受……影响或被……推动。

sentences.en: Holly says that too many emotions can lead to a lack of precision and focus.
sentences.zh: Holly说，过多的情绪会导致缺乏精准度和专注力。

sentences.en: In a football match, high-pressure scenarios like penalties, corners and free kicks offer rare moments of stillness.
sentences.zh: 在一场足球比赛中，像点球、角球和任意球这样高压的场景提供了难得的平静时刻。

sentences.en: Here's Niklas Häusler, founder and CEO of Neuro 11, talking to the BBC World Service.
sentences.zh: 这里是Neuro 11的创始人兼首席执行官Niklas Häusler在对BBC世界服务频道说话。

sentences.en: He measures player's brainwaves before these important kicks and teaches them how to stay relaxed.
sentences.zh: 他测量了球员在这些重要射门前的脑电波，并教导他们如何保持放松。

sentences.en: Niklas Häusler If you don't focus right in those moments, and let's say mentally you're all over the place, then it becomes more difficult to, to have an accurate corner and to try to win the game.
sentences.zh: Niklas Häusler 如果你在那些时刻无法集中注意力，比方说你脑子里乱作一团，那么想要精准地罚出角球并赢得比赛就会变得更加困难。

sentences.en: And when we talk about margins, those are the little margins that can make all the difference.
sentences.zh: 当我们谈论微弱优势时，正是这些微小的优势能决定最终的胜负。

sentences.en: If you're mentally all over the place, it's more difficult to kick the ball accurately.
sentences.zh: 如果你脑子里乱作一团，把球踢准就会变得更难。

sentences.en: When we describe something as ' all over the place ' we mean that it's chaotic, disorganised or confused.
sentences.zh: 当我们形容某物“乱作一团”时，意思是它混乱、杂乱无章或糊涂。

sentences.en: Niklas said that small margins can make all the difference to a game.
sentences.zh: Niklas说，微小的差距会对一场比赛产生决定性的影响。

sentences.en: Yes. A margin is a measure of difference.
sentences.zh: 是的。差距是衡量差异的一个尺度。

sentences.en: Here, we're talking about small details that can affect a player's performance or outcome of a match.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们讨论的是能够影响球员表现或比赛结果的微小细节。

sentences.en: Now, speaking of how emotions can affect performance, I think it's time for the answer to your quiz question Georgie.
sentences.zh: 说到情绪如何影响表现，我想是时候公布你的小测验答案了，Georgie。

sentences.en: Yes. I asked you which part of the brain is best known for its role in processing fear.
sentences.zh: 是的。我问你大脑的哪个部分最以为人知的功能是处理恐惧。

sentences.en: And I guessed b) the amygdala. Which was the correct answer!
sentences.zh: 我猜是b) 杏仁核。这就是正确答案！

sentences.en: Well done. The amygdala is associated with our processing of fear and anxiety.
sentences.zh: 干得好。杏仁核与我们对恐惧和焦虑的处理有关。

sentences.en: OK, time for a vocabulary recap. If there is something going on, something interesting or important is happening.
sentences.zh: 好了，到了词汇复习时间。如果有事情正在发生（something going on），意味着有趣或重要的事情正在上演。

sentences.en: Expertise is specialised knowledge or skill gained through study or experience.
sentences.zh: 专业技能（expertise）是通过学习或经验获得的专业知识或技能。

sentences.en: Conscious means involving active thought or attention.
sentences.zh: 有意识的（conscious）意味着涉及积极的思考或注意力。

sentences.en: If something is driven by something, it is influenced by it and pushed forward by it.
sentences.zh: 如果某事是由某事驱动的（driven by），它就会受到该事物的倾斜并被其推动。

sentences.en: All over the place describes a situation or mental state which is disorganised, chaotic or confused.
sentences.zh: 乱作一团（all over the place）描述了一种混乱、无序或糊涂的情况或精神状态。

sentences.en: And finally, a margin is a measure of difference, small details of which can affect an outcome.
sentences.zh: 最后，微弱优势或差距（margin）是衡量差异的尺度，其中的微小细节可能会影响结果。

sentences.en: Once again, our six minutes are up, but remember you can find a free transcript, worksheet and quiz, on our website at bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 我们的6分钟节目又到时间了，但请记住你可以在我们的网站bbclearningenglish.com上找到免费的节目文稿、练习册和小测验。

sentences.en: Goodbye for now. Goodbye!
sentences.zh: 先说到这里。再见！
